title: "startServer (stem-bot-v2: src/index.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_token: discordToken = process.env.DISCORD_TOKEN
    q_check_token --> q_error: discordToken is undefined
    q_check_token --> q_login: discordToken is defined
    q_error --> [*]: process.exit(1)
    q_login --> q_keepalive: await loginDiscordBot(discordToken)
    q_keepalive --> q_listen: startKeepAlive()
    q_listen --> [*]: app.listen(PORT)

    note right of q_check_token
        INV-001: DISCORD_TOKEN must be set before server starts
        INV-002: Server binds to PORT from env or defaults to 3000
    end note

title: "authMiddleware (stem-bot-v2: src/middleware/auth.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_header: authHeader = req.headers.authorization
    q_check_header --> q_401_missing: !authHeader or !startsWith("Bearer ")
    q_check_header --> q_extract_token: authHeader starts with "Bearer "
    q_401_missing --> [*]: res.status(401) "Bearer token required"
    q_extract_token --> q_check_env: token = authHeader.substring(7)
    q_check_env --> q_500_config: validToken = process.env.API_AUTH_TOKEN is undefined
    q_check_env --> q_compare: validToken is defined
    q_500_config --> [*]: res.status(500) "Server configuration error"
    q_compare --> q_401_invalid: token !== validToken
    q_compare --> q_pass: token === validToken
    q_401_invalid --> [*]: res.status(401) "Invalid token"
    q_pass --> [*]: next()

    note right of q_compare
        INV-001: Token comparison is constant-time unsafe (string equality)
        INV-002: API_AUTH_TOKEN must be set for auth to function
        INV-003: All protected endpoints require valid Bearer token
    end note

title: "healthCheck (stem-bot-v2: src/index.ts /health)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_get_client: client = getDiscordClient()
    q_get_client --> q_fetch_guild: wsStatus = client.ws.status
    q_get_client --> q_fallback: client not initialized (exception)
    q_fetch_guild --> q_guild_ok: guild = await client.guilds.fetch(guildId)
    q_fetch_guild --> q_guild_fail: guild fetch throws error
    q_guild_ok --> q_respond_ok: guildOk = true
    q_guild_fail --> q_respond_degraded: guildOk = false, guildError = e.message
    q_respond_ok --> [*]: res.json(status = "ok")
    q_respond_degraded --> [*]: res.json(status = "degraded")
    q_fallback --> [*]: res.json(status = "ok", discord.error)

    note right of q_get_client
        INV-001: Health endpoint requires no authentication
        INV-002: Exposes internal Discord connection state to unauthenticated callers
    end note

title: "syncRoles (stem-bot-v2: src/api/rolesSync.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: discord_uid = req.body.discord_uid
    q_validate --> q_400: !discord_uid
    q_validate --> q_get_member: discord_uid provided
    q_400 --> [*]: res.status(400)
    q_get_member --> q_404_discord: member = null (getMember)

    q_sync_gen --> q_sync_teams: sync generation roles (add correct, remove others)
    q_sync_teams --> q_sync_leader: sync team roles (add member teams, remove non-member teams)
    q_sync_leader --> q_sync_status: sync leader role based on team_leaders table

    q_respond --> [*]: res.json(success, roles_assigned, roles_removed)

        INV-001: Only one generation role per member at any time
        INV-002: Team roles reflect current member_team_relations
        INV-003: Leader role iff member_id in team_leaders

stateDiagram-v2

    q_iter_next --> q_respond: all members processed
    q_respond --> [*]: res.json(success, synced, failed, total, errors)

title: "corsSetup (stem-bot-v2: src/index.ts CORS configuration)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_env: check process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS

---
title: "authMiddleware (stem-bot-v2: Bearer Token Authentication Middleware)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_extract_header: authHeader = req.headers.authorization
    q_extract_header --> q_check_header: authHeader exists and startsWith("Bearer ")
    q_extract_header --> q_reject_missing: !authHeader or !authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")

    q_reject_missing --> [*]: res.status(401).json("Bearer token required"), return

    q_check_header --> q_extract_token: token = authHeader.substring(7)
    q_extract_token --> q_load_env: validToken = process.env.API_AUTH_TOKEN

    q_load_env --> q_check_env_set: validToken is defined
    q_load_env --> q_server_error: !validToken

    q_server_error --> [*]: logger.error("API_AUTH_TOKEN not set"), res.status(500).json("Server configuration error"), return

    q_check_env_set --> q_compare_token: token === validToken
    q_check_env_set --> q_reject_invalid: token !== validToken

    q_reject_invalid --> [*]: logger.warn("Invalid token attempt"), res.status(401).json("Invalid token"), return

    q_compare_token --> [*]: next()

    note right of q_extract_header
        INV-001: Authorization header must be present and use Bearer scheme
        INV-002: Token comparison uses strict equality (no timing-safe compare)
    end note

    note right of q_load_env
        INV-003: API_AUTH_TOKEN must be set in environment variables for middleware to pass requests
        INV-004: Missing API_AUTH_TOKEN returns 500, not 401 (server misconfiguration)
    end note

    note right of q_compare_token
        INV-005: Only exact token match reaches next() (authorized path)
        INV-006: Token extracted via substring(7) assumes "Bearer " is exactly 7 chars
    end note
